original: 審判の方をちらりと睨むが、審判は涼しい顔して鼻クソをほじっていやがった。「ちくしょう、八百長かよ・・・」

en.text: I shot a look in the referee's direction, but he was putting on a calm face while picking his nose. "Dammit, the fight's a fixup!?"

original: 吸血鬼は睨むだけで人を金縛りにする。

en.text: A vampire can paralyze people just by looking at them.
